auth-token-ok.json.note: Sandbox token lifetime was 3600 seconds, not the documented 5 minutes; http 200 with status string 200

auth-invalid-credentials.json.note: A business error is http 200 with status 500 in the body

auth-missing-parameters.json.note: Several messages joined by a pipe

ipn-register-get-ok.json.note: Note the provider's spelling ipn_status_decription (sic); notification_type 0 is GET

ipn-register-post-ok.json.note: notification_type 1 is POST; same url with another type gets a new ipn_id; same url and type returns the same ipn_id

ipn-register-rate-limited.json.note: Two RegisterIPN calls within about 5 seconds: http 409, body is a wrapper whose message holds an escaped JSON string

ipn-register-invalid-type.json.note: Accepted types are GET or POST

ipn-register-invalid-url.json.note: Only a syntactically invalid url is refused; http and localhost urls were accepted

order-submit-ok.json.note: UGX order; redirect_url has no trailing slash before the query

order-submit-duplicate-reference.json.note: Same merchant reference with a different amount: http 200 and the ORIGINAL order (same tracking id), the new body is ignored

order-submit-reference-too-long.json.note: A 51 character reference gets a generic decline, not a specific code

order-submit-invalid-ipn-id.json.note: Also the reply when an IPN id of another credential pair is used

order-submit-missing-billing-address.jso.note: An empty billing_address object is accepted; a missing one is refused

status-pending.json.note: An unpaid order (and a cancelled one) answers status_code 0, INVALID, error payment_details_not_found 'Pending Payment', top-level status 500. This is PENDING, not a failure

status-unknown-order.json.note: An unknown or malformed tracking id: error invalid_order_tracking_id, all fields null

status-other-credential-pair.json.note: Another merchant's tracking id is refused as bad credentials

refund-rejected-not-completed.json.note: A refund for a code that is not a completed payment

error-missing-token.json.note: No bearer token: http 401, wrapper with escaped JSON in message

error-not-found.json.note: Missing query parameter: http 404, plain message

ipn-list.json.note: Shape observed (status is the string 1 per row, message null); rows fabricated. The sandbox demo merchant list is shared with other developers, so never read it back as ours

status-completed-card.json.note: Built from the documented field list and the documented sample; field set matches the observed pending reply

status-completed-mobile-money.json.note: payment_method value for mobile money is documented as a family (MPESA, MTN, TIGO); exact UGX values unobserved

status-completed-overpaid.json.note: Paid amount above the order amount: our test case, shape documented

status-failed.json.note: The documented sample spells the description Failed (title case) while the field text says FAILED: the adapter must compare case-insensitively and trust status_code

status-reversed.json.note: Only the code table documents reversed; body invented from the same field set

status-invalid.json.note: INVALID with the error object empty has never been observed; the observed INVALID always carried payment_details_not_found (see status-pending)

refund-ok.json.note: Documented sample only: a refund needs a completed payment, so the success path could not be reached

ipn-notification-post-body.json.note: Documented, not observed: a registered POST IPN carries this JSON body; a GET IPN carries the same three names as query parameters

ipn-acknowledgement.json.note: Documented sample, not observed: JSON echoing the three identifiers, status 200 (received and processed) or 500 (received, could not process); the docs show status as a number here although the API replies use a string

callback-query.json.note: Documented, not observed: query parameters appended to callback_url when the payer returns; no status in it
